subject: maths
question: An article is sold for Rs. 4400 at a loss of 20 percent. What is the cost price of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 4400

Loss Percentage = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 - Loss Percentage)

**Calculation:**

Loss Percentage = 20% = 20/100 = 0.20

CP = SP / (1 - Loss Percentage)

CP = 4400 / (1 - 0.20)

CP = 4400 / 0.80

CP = 4400 × (1 / 0.80)

CP = 4400 × 1.25

CP = 5500

**The cost price of the article is Rs. 5500.**
